faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre Visakhapatnam (HBCH&RC Visakhapatnam) through M/S Innovsource Services Pvt. Ltd. for healthcare positions in Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this vacancy?
faq.answer: The post announced under this notification is Technician (CSSD) in the healthcare sector located in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Technician (CSSD) position under advertisement number OS/VIZAG/26/35.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Eligible candidates are required to directly attend the walk-in interview at the designated venue with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Technician (CSSD) position is scheduled to be held on 09 October 2026 at the specified venue in Visakhapatnam.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a 12th Std. in Science with a Diploma in C.S.S.D. and 3 years of experience, OR a B.Sc. degree with 1 year of experience in the C.S.S.D. department.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years. Age relaxation may be granted to exceptional candidates based on committee recommendations.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Technician (CSSD) role will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 23,870/- per month on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: Candidates need to report to the HRD Department, First Floor, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, for the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring an updated resume, a recent passport-size photograph, photocopies and originals of their PAN card, Aadhaar card, educational certificates, and one set of self-attested copies.
